name: Play Cricket POTM
description: Fetches match data from Play Cricket API and analyses performances to recommend Player of the Match for Group A and Group B

then.prompt: Run the Play Cricket POTM analysis. Execute the script at .kiro/scripts/play_cricket_mcp.py with --group both. The PLAY_CRICKET_API_TOKEN environment variable must be set. After getting the output, present the results in a formatted table showing top performers per match and overall POTM recommendation for each group. Apply the analysis criteria from .kiro/steering/play-cricket-potm.md to provide context-aware recommendations beyond just the raw scores.
